scope: Official NYC Department of Design and Construction public building, civic, public-safety, cultural, library, and public-realm milestone pages from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19. Discovery stopped on user request; this file uses the already-found official DDC pages that were absent by normalized DDC URL from the repository context checked in this round.

validation.duplicate_check: Normalized DDC URLs from the already-scanned repository context were compared against the candidate source_url values before writing. This is a URL-level exclusion, not a guarantee that the same project is absent under another source.
